validation.base_geometry: frozen P1.4/IF10 quality, point and hull floors

learning.relation: same reciprocal ratio and validator controls

query.policy: Keep the first selected evidence window and protect one nonoverlapping old timeline fallback. Choose closest to midpoint of the longest unsupported A-tail/next-B interval. Without a usable interval use midpoint of largest baseline PTS gap. No ground-truth times.

selection.baseline: IF12 short-edge shadow for development; V/uniform/S2/S2+roles/K/IF11 K retained

constraints: Never use evaluation frame coordinates or marks for automatic planning. 24 manual roots and 24 auto-2 audit roots run in isolated development review only.

No forced merge or physical identity. No path or chronological propagation without direct third-view observation. Freeze before evaluation. Only one new weight set, only E0/E1 and conditional E2/E3, no E4.
